description:
Create and activate a new REST API integration named 'FastTrack_Logistics' for a third-party logistics provider. 

1. Go to System > Extensions > Integrations.
2. Add a new integration with Name 'FastTrack_Logistics' and Email 'api@fasttrack.com'.
3. In the API tab, set Resource Access to 'Custom'. Grant access ONLY to:
   - Sales > Operations > Orders > Actions > View
   - Catalog > Inventory > Products
4. Save the integration.
5. Activate the integration (click Activate, then Allow) to generate the credentials.

Use the admin password 'Admin1234!' when prompted.
